messages.subject: Technical replicates with DIA data
parts:
Dear all,

We're currently trying to run an analysis with SWATH data acquired on an AbSciex instrument. We know that the package works with three different conditions, three biological replicates for each, and with an analysis at the peptide level. We then acquired another block of the same samples under the same conditions, and we're trying to include them as technical replicates. From what I understand from the manual, MSstats will automatically detect technical replicates as long as they have the same BioReplicate ID. But when we try running dataProcess, we get the following error:

Error in dataProcess(skyline.MSstats.export.MS2) : 
  Please remove duplicate rows in the list above.


Is our data structured incorrectly, or is MSstats unable to handle technical replicates for DIA data? The information regarding our data is below:

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: Technical replicates with DIA data
parts:
Dear Grace,

MSstats detects technical replicates if there are different 'Run' IDs with the same 'Sample' IDs in the same condition. For example,

Condition    BioReplicate  Run
group1           sample1      run1
group1           sample1      run2
group1           sample1      run3

easy way to check the correct annotation or not, please use the line below. could you try this first?

unique(skyline.MSstats.export.MS2[,c("Condition","BioReplicate","Run")]

(If you are not sure, please send me the output of commend above.)

hope to be helpful.

-Meena
